## `GET /price-book`

The price book, with the analysis.infra\_pricing and token\_pricing blocks new runs get.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                          |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [PriceBookResource](/reference/api/models/#pricebookresource) |

## `PUT /price-book`

Replace the price book. Runs already made keep the prices they carry.

**Request body:** [PriceBook](/reference/api/models/#pricebook) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                          |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [PriceBookResource](/reference/api/models/#pricebookresource) |

## `DELETE /price-book/datasheet`

Removes the uploaded token-price datasheet.

| Status | Meaning             | Body |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None |

## `GET /price-book/datasheet`

The uploaded datasheet, byte for byte; 404 without one.

| Status | Meaning             | Body |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | None |

## `PUT /price-book/datasheet`

Upload the token-price datasheet (LiteLLM's model-price JSON): runs priced by the datasheet fetch it from the api, so an install with no internet access can price by the token.

**Request body:** `object` (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                          |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [PriceBookResource](/reference/api/models/#pricebookresource) |
